changes: New: Auto Size — draw past the edge of the paper and the page grows by a whole page in that direction, and shrinks back when the shapes leave. On for new drawings (Design › Auto Size).
Fix: Flip and rotate groups — a group flips and turns as one piece about its own centre and keeps its angle, instead of each part turning on its own.
New: Lines and arrows flip and turn about their middle; Ctrl+R, Ctrl+H and Ctrl+J rotate and flip.
MCP: arrange_flip and arrange_rotate; shape_update sets a group's angle; page_set auto_size.
